bounded_host_request.command:
python3 -c 'import subprocess,json,http.client
from pathlib import Path
rows=subprocess.check_output(["ps","-eo","pid,args"],text=True).splitlines()
pids=[f[0] for row in rows if len(f:=row.strip().split(None,1))==2 and f[1].startswith("python3 /home/admin1/projects/ai-core/") and "--serve --exclusive-traffic" in f[1]]
assert len(pids)==1,"GATE_PROCESS_NOT_UNIQUE"
env=dict(v.split(b"=",1) for v in Path("/proc/"+pids[0]+"/environ").read_bytes().split(b"\0") if b"=" in v)
key=(env.get(b"AI_CORE_API_KEY") or env.get(b"LLAMA_SWAP_API_KEY") or b"").decode()
assert len(key)>=16,"GATE_TOKEN_NOT_ACCESSIBLE"
h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+key}
c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",18181,timeout=135)
c.request("GET","/v1/models",headers=h);r=c.getresponse();b=r.read()
assert r.status==200,(r.status,b[:100])
models=json.loads(b)["data"];assert models,"MODELS_EMPTY"
mid=models[0]["id"]
body=json.dumps({"model":mid,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say OK"}],"max_tokens":2,"stream":False})
c.request("POST","/v1/chat/completions",body=body,headers={**h,"Content-Type":"application/json"})
r=c.getresponse();o=r.read(1024*256);print("AI_CORE_REAL_GATE_POST_STATUS",r.status,"JSON",bool(o and o.startswith(b"{")),"BYTES",len(o))
assert r.status==200
c.close()'
